$ cage query saved
saved · the tokens a tool kept out of the prompt (GROSS)
  formula:  saved = raw_alternative − actual   (in the receipt's own unit — usually tokens)
  GROSS: the tokens spent USING the tool — the invoking turn, the context a
  hook injected — are NOT subtracted. `cage query gross-vs-net` explains.
  method:   inherits the receipt's method — measured only if the tool truly measured it.
  code:     cage/savings.py · cage/graphifychat.py · cage/schema.py
